label: true
articleText: Earth's average surface temperature has risen about 2 degrees Fahrenheit since the late 19th century, driven largely by carbon dioxide emissions and other human activities.

evidence.title: NASA climate evidence
evidence.snippet: The planet has warmed by about 2 degrees Fahrenheit since the late nineteenth century, largely because of increased carbon dioxide emissions.

label: false
articleText: The Food and Drug Administration announced that vaccines cause autism.

evidence.title: Debunking False Vaccine Claim
evidence.snippet: The FDA made no such announcement, and evidence does not link vaccination to autism.

label: misleading
articleText: Not a single childhood vaccine on the schedule has ever been through a double-blind placebo-based trial before licensure, so their risk profile is unknown.

evidence.title: Vaccine safety testing claim
evidence.snippet: The claim uses an artificially narrow definition of placebo and misunderstands vaccine safety trials; childhood vaccines undergo safety testing before approval.

label: false
articleText: Changes in animal behavior can reliably predict the timing, location, and magnitude of earthquakes.

evidence.title: Earthquake Facts and Fantasy
evidence.snippet: Animal behavior cannot be used to predict earthquakes because no reproducible connection has been established.

label: misleading
articleText: A temperature graph covering 2015 through 2022 proves that Earth is cooling and carbon-driven global warming is a hoax.

evidence.title: Temperature graph misrepresented
evidence.snippet: The short period was taken out of context; the complete 140-year series shows a strong warming trend.

label: true
articleText: Two doses of measles vaccine are about 97 percent effective at preventing measles.

evidence.title: Measles Vaccine Recommendations
evidence.snippet: Two doses of measles vaccine are 97 percent effective at preventing measles.
